method: Read-only structural pass over the retained host relay trace. Only counts, tool names, command prefixes and file paths of the public target repository were extracted; no prompts, generations, source text or summaries were exported.
scope: Generations after the leader's planning report (index 34 onward). Includes compaction generations separately. No reviewer was reached.
observedCheckResults: Every observed targeted test run after the edits reported zero failures; one format check failed and the model fixed it with Prettier; a later full format check and typecheck completed.

comparison.note: Ended on a terminal HTTP 504 before any check or report.

harnessErrorsObserved: None: no tool errors, no rejected report, no provider failure and no unparseable tool arguments.
runtimeObservation: The checkpoint snapshot runs git add -A, so after a checkpoint the agent's git diff is empty while git diff --cached shows the change. The model ran git status/diff repeatedly and once unstaged the index; the next snapshot re-stages everything, so the saved artifact is unaffected. Recorded as a follow-up, not changed in this release.
classification: observed model behavior in one interrupted run; not a reliability estimate
conclusion: Gemini 3.8 Flash as coder issued one tool call per generation, investigated for 175 generations before editing, then repeatedly re-verified passing checks without submitting the available done report. No harness defect was identified. Gemini is not recommended for the coder role; owners may still select it.
limits: Single interrupted run; final implementation artifact was not exported; check outcomes are classified from bounded tool-result patterns. Causal attribution to model behavior is a hypothesis supported by the absence of harness errors and the comparison runs, not a controlled experiment.
